title: VOL (Airport Agent, No ACNP) ? INVOL (OPR) � Promise = Last VOL Before OPR
description:
Customer voluntarily changed their flight at the airport (airport office ID, no ACNP, no disruption context = VOL), then AC applied an OPR (Operational Re-protection = INVOL). Validates that the promise updates to the last VOL arrival (12:00) and that the subsequent OPR does NOT further update the promise.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Isabelle Fortier); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; Change 1 (D-3): Airport VOL (airport office ID, no ACNP, no disruption) ? new arrival 12:00; Change 2 (D-0): OPR (YTOAC00PR) ? new arrival 17:00; Actual arrival: 17:00; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
